facts.fact: The Interior Ministry says the National Identity Register Regulations (L.I. 2111) are amended by L.I. 2523, a legislative instrument (regulations) made under the identity register law, in effect from 9 June 2026.
facts.system: National Identity Register Regulations (L.I. 2111), as amended by L.I. 2523

facts.fact: The Interior Minister says L.I. 2523, signed 2 March 2026, gazetted 27 March 2026 and effective 9 June 2026, requires organisations offering services under Regulation 7 of L.I. 2111 to verify identity through the NIA biometric verification system or approved match-on-card devices.

systems.tiers: banks, telecommunications companies, hospitals, educational institutions, government agencies
